address: 711 N. Edgewood Avenue, Wood Dale, Illinois, 60191

reading.body:
Element Critical CH2 sits on 151,000 square feet of technical space in Wood Dale, Illinois, with 7 MW of published IT capacity. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 7 MW supports roughly 175 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a more typical colocation mix, the same power reaches around 700 racks. The operator publishes no breakdown of how that power is distributed across the floor, so the usable rack count for any given workload depends on density assumptions the campus has not stated.

The three certifications qualify this campus to host regulated workloads. PCI DSS qualifies it for payment card data environments. HIPAA qualifies it for protected health information. ISO 27001 qualifies it for workloads requiring a certified information security management system. None of those certifications speaks to AI-specific requirements such as high-density power distribution or low-latency interconnect, and the operator publishes no claims on those points.

Among the 44 Illinois facilities this site has mapped, only 6 publish a megawatt figure, and their combined total is 236 MW. CH2's 7 MW places it fifth by published capacity in that group, representing roughly 3 percent of the state's published total. That ranking reflects a modest footprint relative to the larger Illinois campuses on record. Whether 7 MW is the site's ceiling or a published partial figure is not stated by the operator.
